non_claims: The install-tree hashes describe this repository build. The published crate ships source and documentation only; no binary is in the crate payload.
Byte reproducibility of the DSOs across toolchains, machines or images is not claimed. The v1r freeze establishes committed-install identity only; no cold rebuild was performed for this re-bind.

The GCM SET_IV_FIXED -1 sentinel fix is a behavioural change (the provider now receives SIZE_MAX and copies ivlen, as the authority returns 1); it moved no obligation count in the v1r closure, which is dispositionally identical to the accepted v1q run.

This receipt does not carry any obligation count. The accepted v1r closure (evidence/closure-ssh-v1r.json, evidence/inventory-sshd-v1r.json) carries 312 obligations at 90 DISCHARGED / 222 BLOCKED / 0 UNKNOWN, and element 7 remains FAIL.
